items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: we got a professor by the name of Joe Telesco... he had, I believe, 15 men that started... he'd stop you, and he'd tell you who made the mistake... So, we was playing one year, and he said, how would you boys like to play on the carnival parades?

ctx.x: I was wondering about the very first music you heard when you were a boy. What kind of music did you hear when you were a boy?

Well, there was a bunch of boys. They wanted to start a brass band, and they asked me about would I get in it. I said, well, yes, if you're going to study music. So I said, well, how are you going to do? You're going to have a professor to, so we got a professor by the name of Joe Telesco. Understand? Yeah. He was a Spanish man, but he was a first-class musician, and he had, I believe, 15 men that started, and whenever he first started this, he started, we'd play eight bars of a piece that was written, you…
About how old were you when you had that band?
